intro: This Product User Manual offers comprehensive guidance for the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service's Medium-Resolution Vegetation Phenology and Productivity (MR-VPP) product suite, Version 5.0 Issue 2.0. It provides essential information for accessing, interpreting, and applying these pan-European land monitoring products, covering the 2000-2025 period at 500m spatial resolution. The document details the Plant Phenology Index (PPI) time-series and Vegetation Phenology and Productivity (VPP) parameters, alongside critical quality assurance layers and data formats. It assists scientists, regulators, and data engineers in understanding product content, limitations, and best practices for assessing vegetation seasonal dynamics and ecosystem productivity.
